semanticAndStyleSelfReview.method: Owner translated the complete Japanese-only packet directly, compared all60section paragraphs,7lesson metadata sets and7questions/28specific rationales to Japanese, then read the connected respectful adult Nepali prose in full. Own earlier Nepali wording/profile used only to preserve terminology, without another target locale, pivot or semantic cross-review. Structure counts support but do not replace semantic/style self-review.
checks: Preserved bathing cleanliness/infection-risk reduction plus refreshment, relaxation, satisfaction and rhythm; washing is not proof of no infection, personal comfort not schedule completion. Warming/vascular dilation/blood flow/metabolism, muscle-joint pain/easier movement, GI/appetite effects remain state-dependent without treatment/joint-recovery promise.

Preserved separate changing-room/bathroom temperature difference and water heat checks, dry floor insufficient; slippery floor/steps/route/support/equipment damage-position, personal mobility/sitting ability and required helpers checked in individual plan.

Preserved prebath day condition/wishes, explanation of purpose/content/help and consent; avoid empty stomach/immediately after meal for digestion/absorption reason, personal eating time/state and no staff-availability-only override. Personal drinking conditions/plan, no universal equal quantity, clothing/towel preparation and personal clothing choice retained.

Preserved prebath toilet wish for possible urinary urge, no compulsory excretion for all; seating/supplies/personal actions prepared. Shame/privacy/necessary exposure and explained observation/shielding, consent-bound skin observation and exact redness/pain/wound location/state reported to health professionals. Stop unsafe/unwell forced continuation and seek help/medical contact per institutional procedure; no text-only unfamiliar transfer/bath assistance.

Preserved grooming scope face/hair/beard/nails/clothing/oral cleanliness, identity/social contact not staff appearance preference; clothing thermal/skin protection plus season/activity/body/mind/comfort/movement, no age-only colour/style. Habits/makeup/hair/values, remaining physical-mental function and possible motivation/rhythm without universal improvement promise.

Preserved personal colour/order choice despite physical help, retained own actions and only necessary assistance. Hair consent not generalized to makeup/all clothing changes; refused portion versus present wish separated. Unnecessary exposure avoided, pain/fatigue/stop request and later tightness/wrinkles/comfort/skin checked, buttons alone not proof of comfort.

Preserved home IADL habits/preferences beyond task count, entire menu/materials/cooking/plating-serving/cleanup chain, health/disease/allergy/personal preference and agreed conditions. Food life/health/nutrition meaning, heating/cutting adjusts state/ease, long boiling not universal better absorption; no unilateral menu/form/treatment restriction change.

Preserved country/region and within-region variation, seasonal/festival personal meaning and osechi as example. Trash/dust/dirt removal plus familiar placement/emotional security, item may be important; before moving/disposal confirm kept items/location/disposal scope and consent, cleaning request not free permission to move glasses, wheelchair use does not remove expressed wishes.

Preserved clothing/sheets/bedding separate collection/material-label wash/dry/clean return, no universal handwash/outdoor drying or drying-only disinfection claim. Blood/stool/vomit contamination needs precautions without waiting diagnosis, standard precautions/PPE/hand hygiene/collection and dirty-clean flows, institution/risk-based handling; do not shake/spread contaminated cloth, quiet prescribed container/bag collection, product/material/institution instructions not picture-derived disinfectant/detergent concentration/wash temperature.

Preserved access to path/stairs/bath/toilet, non-slip/rails and raised-curled mat-edge trip risk together with actual gait/path; no mat-presence-only safe/danger conclusion. Temperature/humidity/ventilation/privacy/emotional security and assistive equipment enlarging possible activity; clean room insufficient if call button unreachable or unwanted disposal.

Preserved dignity/human rights despite need for care, person as agent not staff values imposed; QOL includes satisfaction/happiness/meaning, not ability count/health numbers alone. Normalization includes disability-neutral rights/community identity/prejudice reduction/mutual support, not equalizing actions/preferences.

Preserved physical and mental independence, retained capacity/will with necessary help, daily activities and schedule diagram as example not universal hours. Health/home skills/home/family/community/social/country/culture/custom/experience all considered, no staff-only norm or all care recipients passive stereotype; meaningful chosen activity, safety and personal agency maintained.

Preserved privacy exposure boundary/observation explanation, personal info age/address/history/photo restricted by need/recipient/scope/consent/procedure. One-task consent not photo/new contact channel permission; hidden name does not authorize private SNS or personal-contact record transmission, authorized channel/recipient and no overheard detail.

Preserved freedom-limiting examples limbs tied/bed rails preventing getting out/locked exit/belt preventing standing/excess medication suppressing action, purpose and actual restriction not device name. Possible physical/mental harm and dementia anxiety/confusion, safety restriction not guaranteed improvement; organizational restraint-free alternatives, no one-worker method decision.

Preserved five abuse types and concrete bodily/psychological/neglect/economic/sexual examples, multiple concurrent harms, withheld necessary food for compliance as neglect plus fear. Protection first rather than one-label completion, suspicion-stage safety/facts-time-person words separated, no waiting own legal certainty, immediate help/medical link under urgent institutional procedure.

Preserved institutional reporting plus content-appropriate municipality consultation/report channels, privacy not reason to block necessary protection/proper reporting, necessary scope/correct office and no legal adjudication delegated to this material.

Preserved person-centred multi-professional roles: physician diagnosis/treatment, nurse care/clinical assistance with physician/dentist directions when needed, care worker observation not independent diagnosis/treatment change. PT movement/OT daily activity/ST language-hearing-swallowing, coordinated not interchangeable; dietitian nutrition/energy/form/menu, cooking staff allocated confirmed conditions, care worker actual eating/amount/wishes.

Preserved dentist assessment/treatment, denture pain/oral wound location/person complaint to confirmation, no care-worker filing/treatment; care-plan specialist/social worker life/welfare consultation/co-ordination/planning, person then necessary family/contacts, family view not automatic substitute for personal wish.

Preserved eating/swallowing difficulty plus unknown current food form: observation and unconfirmed directions to responsible person, nurse/dietitian/ST evaluation and plan, no arbitrary cutting/thickening/energy. Service-coordination plan does not prove service delivered, contacted recipient/confirmed conditions/action result and observation versus speculation separately shared; knowing ST title does not enlarge authority to change menu.

Preserved home-visit/day-attendance/residential differences of place/time/help and all three concrete service examples, classification not personal eligibility. Assessment information/problem analysis then individual goals/concrete plan then implementation, personal desired life rather than staff timetable.

Preserved post-implementation personal reaction/state, progress versus goal and fit of plan; count/written plan not evidence of effectiveness/achievement. Missing information triggers renewed collection/goals/method revision, recurring process. Schedule/actual assistance/reaction-result/evaluation and achievement remain distinct in case plus all four specific rationales.

All7lesson titles/objectives/contexts/art captions retain original limitations, and all28specific option rationales remain complete. No invented gender/age/kinship/diagnosis/instructions. All7effective readings are absent and omitted; no figureCaptionsJa keys occur.
